sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: People in romantic relationships often share things in common.
sentences.zh: 处于恋爱关系中的人们往往有共同点。

sentences.en: A love with the same sports team, maybe the same religion, sometimes a common profession.
sentences.zh: 比如喜欢同一支运动队，可能有相同的宗教信仰，有时是相同的职业。

sentences.en: But for some couples, the similarities go further.
sentences.zh: 但对一些情侣来说，相似之处远不止于此。

sentences.en: The girl that I'm dating now, we have the same birthday, which is kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 我现在约会的女孩，我们生日是同一天，这挺酷的。

sentences.en: My fiancé Israel and I have the same birthday, which is something we discovered on our second date.
sentences.zh: 我和我的未婚夫以色列生日是同一天，这是我们在第二次约会时发现的。

sentences.en: You could say this isn't so surprising.
sentences.zh: 你可能会说这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: There are lots of people in the world, and sooner or later,
sentences.zh: 世界上有很多人，迟早有一天，

sentences.en: some people are going to get together with others who happen to have the same birthday.
sentences.zh: 有些人会和恰好生日相同的人走到一起。

sentences.en: But there's evidence this may be more than just a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 但有证据表明，这可能不仅仅是巧合。

sentences.en: Having a common birthday seems to actually draw people closer to one another.
sentences.zh: 拥有共同的生日似乎确实能让人们更加亲近。

sentences.en: When I first went to a new hairstylist, we found out that we had the same birthday,
sentences.zh: 当我第一次去一位新发型师那里时，我们发现我们的生日是同一天，

sentences.en: and we called each other birthday twins.
sentences.zh: 我们互称对方为“生日双胞胎”。

sentences.en: And I wound up going to that hairstylist for years, even after she switched salons,
sentences.zh: 结果我找那位发型师理发理了好几年，即使在她换了沙龙之后，
即使在我们搬家之后也是如此。

sentences.en: I would drive 40 minutes to go get my hair cut by her.
sentences.zh: 我会开车40分钟去找她理发。

sentences.en: Some people see so much significance in shared birthdays, or even shared numbers in two birthdays,
sentences.zh: 有些人认为共同的生日，甚至两个生日中共享的数字意义重大，

sentences.en: that they select dates for important events based on those patterns.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们会根据这些模式来选择重要事件的日期。

sentences.en: My friend and I share the same birthday, July 6th, and we are also married on that day.
sentences.zh: 我和我的朋友生日相同，都是7月6日，我们也是在那一天结婚的。

sentences.en: My birthday is October 27th, and with my first husband, his birthday was September 27th,
sentences.zh: 我的生日是10月27日，我第一任丈夫的生日是9月27日，

sentences.en: and we had the opportunity to get married on August 27th.
sentences.zh: 我们有机会在8月27日结婚。

sentences.en: The woman you just heard, Janetta Cravens from Oklahoma City,
sentences.zh: 你刚才听到的那位女士，来自俄克拉荷马城的珍妮塔·克雷文斯，

sentences.en: says her love for people with the same birthday extends beyond her love life.
sentences.zh: 说她对生日相同的人的喜爱已经超出了她的爱情生活。

sentences.en: October 27th is also Teddy Roosevelt's birthday, and so I've always felt a little affinity for him and for his leadership.
sentences.zh: 10月27日也是泰迪·罗斯福的生日，所以我一直对他和他的领导力有一种亲近感。

sentences.en: Shared birthdays, in fact, aren't the only thing that draw people closer to one another.
sentences.zh: 事实上，共同的生日并不是唯一能让人们更加亲近的事物。

sentences.en: Janetta also finds herself drawn to people who happen to have the same name.
sentences.zh: 珍妮塔发现自己也会被恰好名字相同的人所吸引。

sentences.en: When I meet another Janetta, there's an automatic, like, oh my gosh, I can't believe we have the same name.
sentences.zh: 当我遇到另一个珍妮塔时，会有一种自动的反应，比如，天哪，真不敢相信我们名字一样。

sentences.en: And then it happens to be that we have the same spelling.
sentences.zh: 而且碰巧我们的拼写也完全相同。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you, we've only met two people who have the same spelling as me,
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，我们只遇到过两个拼写和我一样的人，

sentences.en: but I can tell you who they are, and I felt an automatic kinship.
sentences.zh: 但我能告诉你他们是谁，我感到了一种自动的亲缘关系。

sentences.en: These unexpected connections with strangers can be lovely moments.
sentences.zh: 这些与陌生人之间意想不到的联系可能是美好的时刻。

sentences.en: But there's something else at work, too.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他因素在起作用。

sentences.en: Something we may not be aware of.
sentences.zh: 一些我们可能没有意识到的事情。

sentences.en: Something that affects all of us.
sentences.zh: 一些影响着我们所有人的事情。

sentences.en: In Greek mythology, the hunter Narcissus was so enamored of his own beauty
sentences.zh: 在希腊神话中，猎人纳西索斯因为太迷恋自己的美貌，

sentences.en: that he fell in love with a reflection of himself.
sentences.zh: 以至于爱上了自己的倒影。

sentences.en: Modern psychology shows that we all have a little bit of Narcissus in us.
sentences.zh: 现代心理学表明，我们每个人内心深处都有点纳西索斯的影子。

sentences.en: Most of us like people who remind us of ourselves,
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人喜欢那些让我们想起自己的人，

sentences.en: whether that's someone else with the same name or someone with the same birthday.
sentences.zh: 无论是名字相同的人，还是生日相同的人。

sentences.en: Most of the time, such self-love is amusing and harmless,
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，这种自恋是有趣且无害的，

sentences.en: maybe even beneficial, a sign of good self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是有益的，是自尊心强的表现。

sentences.en: But there are times when falling in love with ourselves
or with people who remind us of ourselves can be a real problem.
sentences.zh: 或者爱上那些让我们想起自己的人，可能会成为一个真正的问题。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, what we're calling the Narcissus Effect.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目，我们将探讨所谓的“纳西索斯效应”。

sentences.en: Researchers have long observed a tendency for people to be drawn to others who are like them in some way.
sentences.zh: 研究人员早就观察到，人们倾向于被那些在某些方面与自己相似的人所吸引。

sentences.en: When we hear someone else has the same birthday or the same name,
sentences.zh: 当我们听说某人有相同的生日或相同的名字时，

sentences.en: we feel a little tug of kinship.
sentences.zh: 我们会感到一种亲近感。

sentences.en: Some of us might even be drawn to move to states that sound familiar.
sentences.zh: 我们有些人甚至可能倾向于搬到听起来很熟悉的州去居住。

sentences.en: There's at least a modest tendency for women named Georgia to gravitate toward Georgia,
sentences.zh: 至少有一种适度的趋势，名叫乔治亚的女性倾向于移居乔治亚州，

sentences.en: women named Virginia to gravitate toward Virginia.
sentences.zh: 名叫弗吉尼亚的女性倾向于移居弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: And the more closely the name resembles a state, the bigger the effect appears to be.
sentences.zh: 而且名字与州名越相似，这种效应似乎就越明显。

sentences.en: He's a professor of psychology at Montgomery College in Maryland.
sentences.zh: 他是马里兰州蒙哥马利学院的心理学教授。

sentences.en: He studies something called implicit egotism.
sentences.zh: 他研究一种叫做“内隐自负”的东西。

sentences.en: Which is the idea that many biases are unconscious.
sentences.zh: 这个概念认为，许多偏见都是无意识的。

sentences.en: And one very well-studied bias was egotism,
sentences.zh: 其中一个被深入研究的偏见就是自负，

sentences.en: valuing the self favorably, protecting the self, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 即正面评价自我、保护自我等等。

sentences.en: And so we simply got the idea that there are several different things
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是产生了一个想法，即有几种不同的事物，

sentences.en: that at least to some degree reflect a preference for the self
sentences.zh: 至少在某种程度上反映了对自我的偏好，

sentences.en: and an attraction to things that resemble the self.
sentences.zh: 以及对与自我相似事物的吸引力。

sentences.en: Like having an affinity for someone with the same birthday
sentences.zh: 比如对生日相同的人产生好感，

sentences.en: or someone with the same name.
sentences.zh: 或者对名字相同的人产生好感。

sentences.en: Or even going into a profession that sounds like an echo of your name.
sentences.zh: 甚至从事一种听起来像是你名字回声的职业。

sentences.en: So we originally looked at whether people named Dennis or Denise gravitate toward dentistry.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最初研究的是名叫丹尼斯或丹妮丝的人是否倾向于从事牙科工作。

sentences.en: But we learned pretty quickly that it's really hard to get data on those things.
sentences.zh: 但我们很快发现，获取这些数据真的很难。

sentences.en: So there aren't great directories of medical professionals.
sentences.zh: 因为没有很好的医疗专业人员名录。

sentences.en: There is a guy named Abel who was able to document.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫阿贝尔的人，他能够记录下来。

sentences.en: And I was a reviewer on this paper.
sentences.zh: 而我当时是这篇论文的审稿人。

sentences.en: So now every time you say this, I'm going to jump in and say a guy named Abel who was able to do something?
sentences.zh: 所以现在每次你这么说，我都要插嘴说，一个叫阿贝尔的人能够做某事？

sentences.en: He showed that people whose last name is doctor or whose last name is the word lawyer,
sentences.zh: 他证明了那些姓氏是“医生”或姓氏是“律师”这个词的人，

sentences.en: the name lawyer, gravitated toward those two professions.
sentences.zh: 也就是名字叫律师的人，倾向于从事这两种职业。

sentences.en: There are lots of other examples.
Brett looked at a massive database of millions of Americans,
sentences.zh: 布雷特查看了一个包含数百万美国人的庞大数据库，

sentences.en: names from the recently released 1940 census,
sentences.zh: 来自近期公布的1940年人口普查名单，

sentences.en: to examine if they were broad patterns, like...
sentences.zh: 以考察它们是否属于广泛的模式，例如……

sentences.en: And so we looked at every surname there is,
sentences.zh: 于是我们查看了现存的每一个姓氏，
目前排名前两千的姓氏，

sentences.en: that happens to be a career name.
sentences.zh: 恰好是职业名称的那些。

sentences.en: And we looked at all of them.
sentences.zh: 我们把它们全都看了一遍。

sentences.en: There are 11 of them that are pretty common.
sentences.zh: 其中有十一个非常普遍。

sentences.en: And for every single surname in the 1940 census,
sentences.zh: 对于1940年人口普查中的每一个姓氏，

sentences.en: I think it was 130 million people,
sentences.zh: 我想当时有一亿三千万人，

sentences.en: we were able to show that for every single surname,
sentences.zh: 我们能够证明，对于每一个姓氏，

sentences.en: there was at least a weak tendency
sentences.zh: 都至少存在一种微弱的倾向，

sentences.en: for people to gravitate toward careers
that perfectly matched their last names.
sentences.zh: 与他们姓氏完全匹配的职业。

sentences.en: So the obvious thing to say, of course,
sentences.zh: 所以显而易见的说法当然是，

sentences.en: is that the reason you have a slightly larger number of carpenters,
sentences.zh: 之所以木匠（Carpenter）的数量稍微多一点，

sentences.en: is that the name carpenter probably originated
sentences.zh: 是因为“木匠”这个姓氏很可能起源于

sentences.en: from families who were in carpentry.
sentences.zh: 那些从事木工行业的家庭。

sentences.en: And so there is some kind of ancestral connection
to the profession that is driving both the names and the choices.
sentences.zh: 促使他们既选择了这个姓氏，也选择了这个职业。

sentences.en: But if you do the math,
you pretty quickly see it gets to be a pretty tiny percentage of people.
sentences.zh: 很快就会发现这只占极小比例的人群。

sentences.en: So if you assume that even over 10 generations,
sentences.zh: 所以，假设即使经过10代人，

sentences.en: there's a 50% chance that you did what your dad did
sentences.zh: 你有50%的几率从事和你父亲一样的职业，

sentences.en: and a 50% chance that he did what his grandfather did,
sentences.zh: 而他又有50%的几率从事和他祖父一样的职业，

sentences.en: which is probably higher than reality,
sentences.zh: 这可能已经高于现实情况了，

sentences.en: you're talking about a probability of less than 1 in 1,000
sentences.zh: 那么你所谈论的概率还不到千分之一。

sentences.en: In other words, surnames are so old,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，姓氏非常古老，

sentences.en: You know, when a woman named Carpenter
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如一个叫卡彭特（Carpenter，意为木匠）的女人，

sentences.en: marries a guy named Farmer, for example,
sentences.zh: 嫁给了一个叫法默（Farmer，意为农民）的男人，

sentences.en: that that's really, it really just can't account
sentences.zh: 这真的，这真的无法解释

sentences.en: for an effect anywhere near this magnitude.
Brett Pelham has looked at large data sets
sentences.zh: 布雷特·佩勒姆研究了大型数据集

sentences.en: and public records like the Social Security Death Index
sentences.zh: 以及像社会保障死亡指数
或州婚姻记录这样的公共记录，

sentences.en: databases with information about millions of Americans,
sentences.zh: 这些数据库包含了数百万美国人的信息，

sentences.en: and he and his fellow researchers
have seen all kinds of funny effects.
sentences.zh: 发现了各种有趣的效应。

sentences.en: Like, for example, one listener called in to say
sentences.zh: 比如，有一位听众打来电话说，

sentences.en: she and her husband were both born
sentences.zh: 她和她丈夫都是出生在

sentences.en: on the 25th day of different months.
This isn't as uncommon as you might think.
sentences.zh: 这并不像你想象的那么罕见。

sentences.en: Beyond what you might expect by mere chance,
sentences.zh: 超出了你可能预期的纯粹巧合，

sentences.en: there's about a 7% bias in that direction.
sentences.zh: 在这个方向上大约有7%的偏差。

sentences.en: So if you should have 1,000 people doing that,
If that doesn't sound like a lot, you're right.
sentences.zh: 如果这听起来不算多，你是对的。

sentences.en: You should think of implicit egotism

sentences.zh: 看作是一种微小而无形的推动力。

sentences.en: It won't shape what everyone does all the time,
sentences.zh: 它不会一直左右每个人的行为，

sentences.en: but it does shape what some people do some of the time.
sentences.zh: 但它确实会在某些时候影响某些人的行为。

sentences.en: It's when you multiply these small effects
sentences.zh: 当你把这些微小的效应

sentences.en: over hundreds of millions of people
that you start to see lots of examples.
sentences.zh: 你就会开始看到大量的例子。

sentences.en: Brett says that if you really love your birthday,
sentences.zh: 布雷特说，如果你真的很喜欢自己的生日，

sentences.en: Our operational definition of really loving your birthday
sentences.zh: 我们对“真的很喜欢自己的生日”的操作性定义

sentences.en: was getting married on your birthday number.
sentences.zh: 是在你生日数字的那一天结婚。

sentences.en: So if you got married on the 13th of the month,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是在每月的13号结婚，

sentences.en: you were quite a bit more likely to marry another person
sentences.zh: 你更有可能嫁给（或娶）另一个人，

sentences.en: who also had the number 13 as his birthday number.
sentences.zh: 而那个人的生日数字也是13。

sentences.en: Again, Brett calls this an implicit bias for a reason.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，布雷特称之为内隐偏差是有原因的。

sentences.en: You may not be consciously choosing things
sentences.zh: 你可能并不是有意识地在选择这些事情。

sentences.en: as important as your spouse or your profession
sentences.zh: 和你的配偶或职业一样重要

sentences.en: or the place you call home based on arbitrary factors
sentences.zh: 或者基于武断因素而称之为家的地方

sentences.en: like your name or your birthday.
He thinks the bias comes about simply because
sentences.zh: 他认为这种偏见产生的原因很简单，因为

sentences.en: we like our names and our birthdays
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢自己的名字和生日

sentences.en: and have positive associations with them.
sentences.zh: 并对它们有积极的联想。

sentences.en: And so you just associate your name
sentences.zh: 所以你只是把你的名字

sentences.en: with all the wonderful things that come along with that.
sentences.zh: 与随之而来的所有美好事物联系在一起。

sentences.en: And the best bit of evidence I have
that I've never bothered to publish
sentences.zh: 虽然我从未费心去发表它

sentences.en: is there's one part of people's names
sentences.zh: 就是人们名字中有一部分

sentences.en: You know, and the joke about that
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于这个有个笑话

sentences.en: is the sole purpose of a child's middle name
sentences.zh: 说孩子中间名的唯一用途

sentences.en: is to know when he's really in trouble,
sentences.zh: 就是让他知道自己真的惹上麻烦了，

sentences.en: and my additional comment is to know
sentences.zh: 而我的补充评论是，为了知道

sentences.en: if he might be a serial killer someday, right?
sentences.zh: 他将来是否会成为连环杀手，对吧？

sentences.en: So the middle name is not nearly as loved
as the first or the last name.
People feel very ambivalent about their middle name.
sentences.zh: 人们对自己的中间名感到非常矛盾。

sentences.en: There can be other reasons for ambivalence.
sentences.zh: 产生这种矛盾心理可能有其他原因。

sentences.en: when another person has the same birthday.
sentences.zh: 别人和自己同一天生日。

sentences.en: If you were born on April 20th,
Hitler was born on that day too.
sentences.zh: 希特勒也出生在那一天的事实。

sentences.en: Brett finds that if a consumer product
sentences.zh: 布雷特发现，如果某种消费品

sentences.en: happens to have your name on it,
you are more likely to hate that product.
sentences.zh: 你更有可能讨厌那个产品。

sentences.en: People dislike seeing something inferior in the world
sentences.zh: 人们不喜欢看到世界上有劣质的东西

sentences.en: that has their name on it.
As Brett and I were talking,
I realized something a little uncomfortable,
sentences.zh: 我意识到了一件有点令人不安的事，

sentences.en: that I myself had fallen prey to implicit egotism.
sentences.zh: 那就是我自己也成了内隐自负的受害者。

sentences.en: You know, as you're talking right now,
sentences.zh: 你知道，就在你说话的时候，
意识到了关于我自己的事情。

sentences.en: There was a philosopher in India
and he actually taught a philosophy
sentences.zh: 他实际上教授了一种哲学，

sentences.en: And I've always been drawn to the fact
sentences.zh: 我一直被这样一个事实所吸引：

sentences.en: that I find the philosophy of Vedanta
and the fact that Shankara taught that philosophy,
sentences.zh: 而商羯罗教授这种哲学的事实，

sentences.en: But now as I'm listening to you say this,
this could just be implicit egotism.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是内隐自负在作祟。

sentences.en: I've read his work very well,
sentences.zh: 我读过他的著作，读得很透，

sentences.en: So I think in this case,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在这种情况下，

sentences.en: you made the objectively good decision.
sentences.zh: 你做出了客观上正确的决定。

sentences.en: it does make you think, though.
Has this ever happened to you, Brett?
sentences.zh: 布雷特，这种情况发生在你身上过吗？

sentences.en: Do you ever think about yourself
and how implicit egotism is affecting you?
sentences.zh: 以及内隐自负是如何影响你的？

sentences.en: We're getting a little personal here,
sentences.zh: 我们现在谈得有点私人了，

sentences.en: but I can't resist being a little bit personal.
sentences.zh: 但我忍不住想谈得私人一点。

sentences.en: I would say that probably the most dramatic example
sentences.zh: 我想说，最戏剧性的例子可能

sentences.en: His mother's last name was Poland.
And I entered a relationship with her
sentences.zh: 我在提出这个理论之前

sentences.en: not after I developed the theory
sentences.zh: 而不是在提出理论之后
为了验证理论才这么做的。

sentences.en: and you got into a relationship
sentences.zh: 然后你和一位名叫波兰的女士

sentences.en: And we are very different in most other ways.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在大多数其他方面都非常不同。

sentences.en: That's about as much as I'll say about that.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我只能说这么多了。

sentences.en: Are you saying that the names
played some kind of a role?
I have to think it did.
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为起到了作用。

sentences.en: And we were from different backgrounds,
I mean, we come from very different worlds.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们来自非常不同的世界。

sentences.en: And yet I was very attracted to her.
